title: Velvety White Bean and Parmesan Mash
description: Warm beans mash into a soft garlicky side with Parmesan.

steps.title: Set the heat
steps.text: Use the lidded HexClad wok on a medium burner.

steps.title: Build flavor
steps.text: Warm {garlic} in {oil} for 45 seconds without browning.

steps.title: Cook gently
steps.text: Add {beans} and {broth}, cover and simmer 8 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Mash to a creamy consistency, adding warm water if necessary. Fold in {parm} off heat.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers and refrigerate up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze up to 1 month; grains and vegetables soften slightly. Fridge reheat: stir with a spoonful of water over low heat until 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge and warm by the same method. Dairy swap: use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese as applicable. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 252 kcal, 15.4 g protein, 34.4 g total carbohydrate, 6.3 g fat, 8.2 g fiber, 167 mg sodium.
